name: inventory-management-system
description: Inventory, manufacturing and sales system (FIFO stock ledger, workshop, sales, eTIMS)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm:dev -w shared" "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
